contracts: (Missing-target invocation terminates unsuccessfully with no target identity accepted and no target-dependent operation executed.) AND (The route selector resolves the Acceptance package route through the shared capability and rejects its removal or unavailability.) AND (The route selector resolves the VDD package route through the shared capability and rejects its removal or unavailability.)

The dedicated assertion tests must cover the observable intent of ["py", "-3", "-m", "pytest", ".agents/skills/vdd-conformance-exact-cover/tests/validators/readonly_target.py"] using bounded fixtures, explicit arguments and expected exit/verdict assertions. Help output, a schema document alone, or an unstarted validator cannot prove the bound acceptance. Do not invoke live backends or mutate the real repository in a negative fixture.

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
